summary: The complete, executable launch graph for a VolFee pool: deploy the token, mine and CREATE2-deploy the hook precommitted to the exact (token, startPrice, tickSpacing), initialize the canonical dynamic-fee pool (the hook validates the precommit and binds once), add initial liquidity, and trade. Every step is proven end-to-end in test/VolFeeLaunch.t.sol against a real PoolManager.

cases: test_launch_endToEnd_tradable — deploy token, mine+deploy hook, initialize pool, add liquidity, buy; asserts hook address == mined, permission bits == 0x10cc, bound token/poolId exact, base LP fee set, mandatory fee accrued, post-state solvency (hook 6909 == owed).
test_launch_secondInit_reverts_afterBound — a second initialization on any distinct key reverts after the first bind (no capture, no duplication).
executableProof.forkProof: test/fork/VolFeeFork.t.sol runs the same launch + trade against the real mainnet PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90.

steps.note: A standard fixed-supply ERC-20 (the non-quote side). No transfer tax, no rebase, no mint-after-deploy. Sorted against the quote so the pool's currency0/currency1 ordering is deterministic.
steps.rollback: If token deployment fails, nothing else has run — no pool, no hook binding.
steps.postcondition: token address known; distinct from the quote.

hashBound.creationCode: type(VolFeeHook).creationCode (built from the exact pinned solc 0.8.26 / cancun / optimizer-200; see compatibility.lock.json and out/build-info/*)
hashBound.constructorArgs: (poolManager, feeTotalBps, quote, project, initialLpFee, alphaBps, kNum, kDen, minLpFee, maxLpFee, EXPECTED_TOKEN, EXPECTED_SQRT_PRICE_X96, EXPECTED_TICK_SPACING)
hashBound.salt: mined by HookMiner.find so the deployed address's low 14 bits equal the mask 0x10cc; the exact salt/address are content-derived from the creationCode + constructor args.

steps.occupancy: CREATE2 to a mined address; if that address is already occupied the deployment reverts (standard EVM CREATE2 collision), so the launch cannot be front-run at the address level.
steps.rollback: If mining or deployment fails, no pool is bound.
steps.postcondition: hook deployed at the mined address; address low-14-bits == 0x10cc; EXPECTED_TOKEN / EXPECTED_SQRT_PRICE_X96 / EXPECTED_TICK_SPACING are immutably set.

steps.atomicBinding: _afterInitialize REQUIRES the pool's non-quote token == EXPECTED_TOKEN, sqrtPriceX96 == EXPECTED_SQRT_PRICE_X96, and tickSpacing == EXPECTED_TICK_SPACING (else WrongToken / WrongStartPrice / WrongTickSpacing); it also requires a dynamic-fee pool (else NotDynamicFee) and binds ONCE (else PoolAlreadyBound on any later init). This closes first-pool capture: an attacker cannot bind the hook to a foreign token/pool.
steps.rollback: Any mismatch reverts the whole initialize; no partial state (tknCurrency/poolId) is written.
steps.postcondition: hook.poolId == key.toId(); hook.tknCurrency == token; base LP fee set via updateDynamicLPFee; volatility state (lastTick, ewmaVol) initialized.

steps.action: add initial liquidity via the standard v4 modifyLiquidity
steps.custody: LPs own their own positions in the PoolManager. The hook holds NO liquidity and NO pool assets — only its two fee-liability ERC-6909 quote claims (programmableFeeOwed for OWNER, projectFeeOwed for PROJECT), fully accounted (hook 6909 balance == programmableFeeOwed + projectFeeOwed).
steps.rollback: modifyLiquidity is atomic; a failed add reverts without touching the hook.
steps.postcondition: pool has tradable liquidity; hook custody unchanged.

steps.fee: Each swap pays the mandatory Programmable volume fee on EXECUTED gross quote volume: quote-unspecified swaps charge on the executed BalanceDelta (partial-fill-safe); quote-specified swaps charge in beforeSwap and REVERT on a price-limited partial fill or a dust input that leaves no positive AMM leg (executed-basis-or-revert). The LP fee auto-calibrates to realized volatility, bounded to [minLpFee, maxLpFee].
steps.rollback: Any settlement or fee failure reverts the whole swap atomically.
steps.postcondition: mandatory fee accrued on the executed quote; hook solvent (6909 == owed).
